scenario: Build-unit scheduler dispatches steps in dependency order. A linear graph a→b→c (each step Consumes the prior step's Output); the harness scripts cache.key→ActionKey and exec.run→StepOutput, and produce emits each output Product to unblock the next step. run logs each step's id at dispatch — the observed sequence must be a,b,c. Pins the gate/join/dispatch chain on the Product/Step/Output/Consumes model.
rules_ds:
schema Product scope logical:
    name: String key
    pathname: String mutable
    digest: String mutable
schema Step scope logical:
    id: String key
    argv: String mutable
schema Output scope logical:
    name: String key
    step: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
schema Consumes scope logical:
    step: String key
    product: String key
schema Blocked scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Ready scope logical:
    step: String key
schema ActionKey scope logical:
    step: String key
    action_key: String mutable
schema Dispatched scope logical:
    step: String key
schema StepOutput scope logical:
    name: String key
    step: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
    digest: String mutable
service cache.key:
    kwarg step: String
    no response
service exec.run:
    kwarg step: String
    kwarg argv: String
    no response
rule block_input:
    Consumes c
    no Product p where p.name == c.product
->
    emit Blocked logical step: c.step
rule ready:
    Step s
    no Blocked b where b.step == s.id
->
    emit Ready logical step: s.id
rule fetch_key:
    Ready r
    no ActionKey k where k.step == r.step
->
    call cache.key step: r.step nocooldown
rule run:
    ActionKey k
    no Dispatched d where d.step == k.step
    Step s where s.id == k.step
->
    call exec.run step: s.id argv: s.argv nocooldown
    log critical "{s.id}"
rule produce:
    ActionKey k
    StepOutput so where so.step == k.step
->
    emit Product logical name: so.name pathname: so.pathname digest: so.digest
